name: cam-local-capture
description: Consent-gated, multi-instance local capture for NX and PowerMill operator logs.

interface.shortDescription: Capture consented multi-window CAM behavior locally.
interface.longDescription: Adds local-only, redacted NX and PowerMill log capture with explicit first-use consent, per-window runtime status, source checkpoints, labels, export, and deletion controls.
interface.defaultPrompt: Explain how CAM Local Capture protects operator data.
